lead.headline: Wilson needs one more step — and his cover is questionable too
lead.deck: Full practice Friday, still in the protocol. Tuten is cleared; Diggs' 20.3 is the bar Wilson's slot now has to beat.
lead.body: Garrett Wilson practised fully on Friday, but Aaron Glenn says he has one more step before he is cleared, and he is listed questionable. Denzel Boston, his first cover, missed two practices with a toe and is questionable too, though he was back on the field Friday. If Wilson is inactive at 10:30 Sunday, Boston starts if he is active; otherwise DK Metcalf, who plays Sunday night. Bhayshul Tuten was limited Friday and Doug Coen says he is good to go. Justin Jefferson gets Kirk Cousins' first Minnesota start with T.J. Hockenson ruled out. The lineup is the projection lineup; Isaiah Likely has already put up 27.7.
